pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with highly serrated and diffuse edge gradients. Patch area decreases significantly in the posterior hindquarter region, transitioning from large, elongated shapes on the upper flank to smaller, more condensed geometries towards the tail and lower leg.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Complex topological network of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-coordinate or quadri-coordinate. Pixel thickness is relatively consistent across the mid-flank, with noticeable narrowing in the high-density patch regions of the rump.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette visible along the cervical and cranial-thoracic ridge, characterized by short, dense hair tufts.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of small, dark punctate markings or speckling on the light-pigmented skin surrounding the perineal area and tail base.
